text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Individual Events Meet.
Biko Pegasus is in top condition!
Top condition... and yet—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!?
Wh-What are you talking about?!
The real deal is about to start!
There's no way I'd be worrying about stuff
like that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No way at all... *sigh*

A tiny sense of inferiority,
newly sprouted.
It's a feeling many competitors grapple with,
which makes its roots all the deeper.

I want to help her snap out of it,
but there's no time left before the race.
All I can do now is support her as I always
do.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, everyone's already gathering!
Well, here I go, Trainer!

Biko Pegasus looks ahead—
today's lineup is full of remarkably well-built
horsegirls.
It brings back memories of that mock race.
choice_data_list: ...Just do what you always do, and...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...? Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The lead pack is tightly bunched
together!
Biko Pegasus is trailing right behind
them!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...The front is completely blocked...
But if I just do what I always do,
I'll be fine. All right, let's do this!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Here I gooo!! Pegasus Mach—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: You're not... getting past...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —gah?!

The gap she aims for closes in the blink of
an eye. In the fierce jostle,
Biko Pegasus's small frame gets knocked off
course—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Kgh... ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The leaders head into Turn 3 in a tight
cluster!
Biko Pegasus takes a heavy stumble—
can she recover?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't...
make it through...?!
I managed to hold my ground,
but I easily could've fallen...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't like "what I always do"...
These opponents are way bigger and stronger
than the ones in the mock race...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(What do I do? I can't see an opening!
With my build,
forcing my way in will just get me shoved
aside again!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(If it were Brian in this spot...
she'd use that huge stride of hers to blast
right past them in one go...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(If only I could run like Brian...
But I'm—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
choice_data_list: You're the one who gave me courage...
You're the one who gave me courage...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (Never giving up... Me...)

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
["...No matter how many times I fail...
I'll keep fighting till the very end for
justice and everyone's health!!"]

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(That's it.
That's—what makes a real hero!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah,
that's right.
That's "what I always do"!
Even if my stride is short,
even if I get knocked away—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I can get back up as many times as it
takes!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's right, this fight—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —BEGUN!!

Without a single glance astray,
Biko Pegasus dives straight into the lead
pack.

Standing before her is a colossal gate.
Crashing headfirst into such a tightly closed
wall would normally spell disaster.

Yet she doesn't stop. With pure courage,
she pierces through the minuscule gap that
opens for just a split second.

It was the very image of a hero that had
captivated me from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...She won...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
YEAAAAAAAAH!! We did it,
we did it!! Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu!! Hehe,
Trainer...
You called me cool during the race too,
right? I heard ya!

I've thought Biko Pegasus was cool from the
very beginning.
You don't need to be overpowering,
and you don't have to force a brute-strength
breakthrough.

Using that small frame,
pumping those legs with all her might,
facing giant rivals with everything she's
got.
choice_data_list: That's the hero who gave me courage.
That's the hero who gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer... You did something amazing too,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was moping around,
you kept cheering me on the whole time.
You didn't give up either! That's why...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You gave ME courage too!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! So listen up, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer who gave courage to the hero
Biko Pegasus is officially a magnificent
hero themselves!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so, so much!! My hero!!

I received courage. I gave courage back.
And now,
being called a hero...
I've received courage once more.

That's why—
I decided to finally say what I'd been
holding back,
what I hadn't built up the resolve to say
until now.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Will you sign an exclusive contrac...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I honestly felt like we'd already been
under contract this whole time...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding! Of course I will!!
Our united front continues!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's become the one and only tag-team heroes
together!!
